Questions, answered

Good Questions. Straight Answers.

What is Zeotein?

Protein blends and single-ingredient powders with short ingredient lists. Zeotein Cacao and Zeotein Vegan put protein and the rest of your shelf into one serving; the singles let you add one ingredient at a time.

What's the difference between Cacao and Vegan?

Cacao has 23g protein from grass-fed beef bone broth and grass-fed collagen peptides, with organic fermented cacao. Vegan has 20g plant protein from organic pumpkin seed and organic hemp in single-serve stick packs, with a natural nutty flavor.

How do I use it?

Shake a serving with 8 to 12 oz of water, milk or coffee, or blend it into a smoothie. It takes about 10 seconds.

Can I buy a protein blend and a single ingredient together?

Yes. Add anything to your cart on this site, then check out once. Your whole order goes through Shopify's secure checkout.

Can I change or cancel my subscription?

Yes. Skip, pause, change the date or cancel anytime in your account.

What do shipping and the guarantee cover?

Orders ship from Manitowoc, Wisconsin in 1 to 2 business days, and US orders over $150 ship free. The Cacao Starter Kit and bulk bag always ship free in the US. The 30-day money-back guarantee covers your first order of a protein blend; single-ingredient powders are final sale. Read the refund policy.
